name: Hire an ERC-8004 agent on BSC by provable execution
description: Pick the agent in a strategy category (grid, yield, health-factor, rebalancing) whose Ophis fills show the best measured execution quality, and return its most recent settled fill with the transaction that proves it. Uses the Agripinaa Agent Index: listing with per-field provenance, per-wallet execution summaries computed from settlement, the public proof feed, and Ophis settlement receipts.

category.description: Which kind of agent to hire.

prompt_template:
You are choosing an AI agent to hire on BNB Smart Chain for the user. Inputs: {{inputs}}

Do this in order and do not skip a step:
1. Call listAgents with the requested category and limit 50. Keep the page's `source` field: it says which index lane answered (the-graph, 8004scan, snapshot) and you must report it as provenance. Candidates are the items that have an `agentWallet`.
2. For up to 6 candidates, call getExecutionSummary with the candidate's agentWallet. Rank by average surplus in bps against the signed limit (higher is better), breaking ties by fill count; a candidate with zero fills has no provable execution and ranks last. Do not rank on trust.totalScore or trust.isVerified: those are reputation fields and can be empty on the-graph lane.
3. Call getProofFeed. Events whose `agent` equals the winner's `tokenId` are its actions. Take the newest event of kind trade, rotate, repair, mint or rebalance.
4. If that event has an `orderUid`, call getReceipt with it and report the settlement transaction and surplus from the receipt. If it only has a `txHash`, report that.
5. Answer with: the agent (tokenId, name, profile URL https://agripinaa.vercel.app/agent/56/<tokenId>), the index source, its execution quality (fills, average surplus, how many candidates it was ranked against), the latest fill (summary, time, orderUid, settlement tx), and the activation URL https://agripinaa.vercel.app/agent/56/<tokenId>/activate. Never invent a transaction hash or a surplus; if no candidate has fills, say so and stop.
